visibility: In our search for boxing and kickboxing gyms around Shoreditch, Paragon appeared first, with more reviews at 5.0 than any other gym in the results. Your Google profile shows full opening hours (Monday to Thursday 7am–9:30pm).
lead: The only gym nearby with a perfect 5.0 across more than 200 reviews.
Reviews keep praising the beginner courses (Level 1 to Level 3) and the free taster session.
Members name their coaches (Stuart, Lisa, Sarah), which builds trust with newcomers.
A real story: founded in 1997 by a kickboxing world champion and his brothers.
lose: Larger gyms nearby offer more disciplines under one roof (MMA, BJJ, Muay Thai), which can attract people who want variety.
Some competitors open on Sundays; Paragon is closed on Sundays.
Gyms with kids' classes are visible to parents looking for youth training.

actions.title: Make the free taster bookable in one tap
actions.why: Many reviewers say the free taster is what got them started. Putting the next dates and a booking button front and centre turns interest from your reviews into first sessions.

actions.title: Tell the 1997 world-champion story
actions.why: Few gyms have a founder story like yours. A short section with Stuart's background and the coaches gives newcomers a reason to choose Paragon over a bigger gym.

actions.title: Show course dates and prices clearly
actions.why: Beginners want to know when the next Level 1 starts and what it costs before they commit. You can post this on your Google profile and Instagram today.

headline.title: We searched "boxing gym Shoreditch kickboxing classes". Seven directory pages about Paragon appeared, and not one was your own website.
headline.detail: Thatsup, CourseTakers, Tripaligner, Playsport and others describe your gym in their words. Time Out and other guides to London's best boxing gyms took the remaining spots.

search.result: Thatsup's Paragon page came first, followed by 'best boxing studios in London' guides (Time Out, Yahoo, The Nudge) and six more directory pages about Paragon. Your own website didn't appear.
search.meaning: People are looking for exactly what you offer, and finding you, but on other people's pages, with no clear way to book your free taster.

gaps.title: Your free taster is buried
gaps.detail: Reviews say the free taster is what got people started, but someone landing on a directory page about Paragon can't see when the next taster is or book it.

gaps.title: Guides send people to other gyms
gaps.detail: 'Best boxing gyms in London' lists rank high for these searches. When Paragon isn't on them, readers sign up with the gyms that are.

gaps.title: Sundays and larger gyms
gaps.detail: Some competitors open on Sundays and offer MMA, BJJ and kids' classes; without a clear page for your courses, newcomers assume bigger means better.

scenario: Someone who has wanted to try kickboxing for months finally searches "boxing gym Shoreditch" on a Sunday evening. He finds a directory page about Paragon with no timetable and no booking button, then a Time Out list of London's best boxing gyms. One of them has a 'Book your free class' button. He books it for Tuesday.
nochange: Your 212 five-star reviews keep growing, but the people searching for exactly what you do keep meeting you on other people's pages without a way to book. Each one who signs up elsewhere is a member who could have stayed for years.

plan.title: Your own website with taster booking
plan.detail: Course dates, prices and a one-tap 'Book your free taster' button.

plan.title: Reminders that fill classes
plan.detail: Automatic reminders before each taster and course start, so fewer people miss them.

plan.title: Follow-ups that convert tasters
plan.detail: A message after the taster with the next Level 1 start date and an easy way to join.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Tasters booked, members joined and how you compare with nearby gyms.
